lena: Proposal: add a per-cohort 'semaphore' safety for high-impact runtime flags to limit activation throughput and avoid quota/routing storms.
josh: Quick q: is this tokens/sec or activations/sec?
lena: Activations/sec per-flag per-cohort, with small burst and exponential backoff. Default: cap 10/s, burst 50, backoff [10,30,120,600].
ravi: What do callers observe when exhausted? queue or fail?
lena: Fail-fast with Retry-After. Console shows "throttled by safety" and owner can temporarily override with justification.
maya: UX: surface semaphore state, current QPS, recent backoffs, last blocked request id, and a dry-run link. Require 2FA + owner role to force-enable.
devon: Ops metrics suggested: config.activation_rate, config.throttle_count, config.override_requests. Alert if sustained throttle_count > 5/min for prod.
cara: SRE: default fail-mode by risk: infra flags fail-closed, UI flags fail-open. Add oncall-only safemode bypass with audit and TTL. Backoff schedule as proposed.
josh: Implementation: token-bucket in the runtime cache to avoid RPCs. On cache miss, tiny circuit RPC to config service. Perf estimate: ~1% p95 overhead at 10k RPS.
lena: Example dry-run snippet included in RFC (verbatim kept in text field to avoid nested JSON).
configbot: Preflight: schema OK. Warning: telemetry hooks missing for semaphore flags (config.throttle_count). Recommend auto-insert telemetry scaffolding or fail preflight.
ravi: +1 to auto-insert telemetry during preflight.
maya: Console copy: short reason + recommended steps + "open dry-run" button. Timeline view for activations vs blocked events.
devon: I'll draft SLIs/alert windows: initial: alert when throttle_count > 20 in 5m AND activation_rate drops >20% vs baseline.
cara: I'll write safemode runbook: audit, revoke, RBAC, TTL, postmortem checklist.
josh: I'll build perf harness and bench the token-bucket.
lena: Action items: lena -> RFC & PoC; josh -> perf; devon -> SLIs/alerts; cara -> runbook; maya -> console mocks. Reconvene after PoC.
configbot: Reminder: link RFC under /eng/flags/rfcs with preflight id 4418801234.
lena: Thanks :rocket:
